Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Redwood's runtime looked like a great fit for data ingestion patterns we run. We'd like to run a short 30-day pilot for a single ingestion pipeline (non-production) to validate latency and cost.

We do not currently have a PO set up with our vendors for small pilots; would Redwood consider a temporary no-PO payment path for the pilot period? Our procurement team prefers to avoid creating a long-term PO for a one-month evaluation.

If helpful, I attached a W-9 and the one-page SOW outlining scope, cap, and acceptance criteria. Estimated spend for the pilot is $3,200 (not to exceed $5,000). If you need any references or additional evidence, happy to provide.

Attachments: HelioSensors_W9.pdf, HelioSensors_SOW_v1.pdf

- Confirm whether a temporary carveout is acceptable

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear SOW and W-9, received.

Short answer: we can sometimes approve a limited-duration, invoice-only pilot without an upfront PO for small-dollar pilots if we put a few guardrails in place. To move fast, I propose the following conditional approach:

1) Timebox: 30 days (as you requested). We can extend once procurement and finance have a PO in place.
2) Spend cap: $5,000 hard cap (no automatic spend beyond this).
3) Evidence: we need the W-9 (got it) plus a short SOC2 self-attestation (or last-12-months security summary) and contact for billing.
4) Commercial: sign a short acknowledgement (I can share our one-paragraph pilot addendum).
5) Finance notification: I'll loop in procurement for an approval record and invoice routing.

If these controls work for HelioSensors, I'll forward documentation to Procurement for exception approval. Please confirm billing email and whether HelioSensors requires an invoice to a specific legal entity name.

On the attachments: your SOW looks good; one minor ask — can you add an acceptance test bullet (e.g., end-to-end latency under X ms at Y qps) so we have a measurable sign-off?

I'll follow up internally and try to get a temporary carveout approved today.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Laura — forwarding HelioSensors' request. Short summary below and my recommended guardrails. Would you or Procurement sign off on this temporary carveout? If yes, please reply all so I can close the loop with HelioSensors.

Summary:
- External: HelioSensors, Inc. (cloud vendor for edge telemetry) wants a 30-day pilot without a PO.
- Expected spend: $3.2k estimate, not to exceed $5k.
- Documents submitted: W-9 and SOW (attached).

Recommended controls (conditional approval):
- Timebox: 30 days
- Hard spend cap: $5,000
- Security evidence: SOC2 self-attestation or security summary (they said they can provide)
- Simple one-paragraph pilot addendum signed by HelioSensors and Redwood (I can draft)
- Finance: invoice-only routing to billing@heliosensors.com; Redwood will generate an invoice at pilot completion or earlier if requested

Rationale: small-dollar pilot, fast buy-in channel, low operational risk if we enforce the cap and timebox. We should require the security summary and add a short acceptance test in the SOW.

If Procurement prefers, we can require a Purchase Order but that will likely add 7–10 business days to schedule. HelioSensors is asking to start next week if possible.

Attachments: forwarded W-9 and SOW.

Thanks — can you advise?

— Mina

Mina / Marissa / Emma — thanks for the summary and materials. I've reviewed the SOW and W-9 and discussed with Finance. Procurement will approve a time-limited invoice-only pilot exception with the following binding conditions:

1) Duration: 30 days starting on first invoice generation date (we'll accept your email-confirmed start).
2) Spend cap: $5,000 maximum. Any spend beyond that requires an approved PO.
3) Security: provide a brief SOC2 self-attestation PDF or a security posture memo (attached to the procurement record) before pilot start.
4) Contractual: sign the attached one-paragraph pilot addendum (I attached as 'Pilot_Addendum_Redwood.pdf') which references the SOW and spend cap.
4) Finance ops: invoices must be issued to billing@heliosensors.com with Redwood's remit instructions; Procurement will create an internal exception record PROC-4721.

I'll mark PROC-4721 as "approved - pilot carveout" once Mina confirms HelioSensors accepts the conditions and returns the signed addendum and security attestation. Please note this is a narrow exception for evaluation only — not a change to our PO mandate policy.

Emma — welcome aboard for the pilot. Mina, please attach the signed addendum and security attestation in the Jira ticket and notify Finance to expect the first invoice.
